question: How do conceptually conditioned practitioners contemplate the supreme Lord?
premises: Some practitioners are shaped by streams of conceptual impressions arising from scripture.
They contemplate the all-pervading supreme Lord through intrinsic qualities.
This contemplation may be total or partial.
inference: Even those conditioned by conceptual impressions can approach the supreme Lord through his intrinsic qualities, wholly or in part.
uncertainties: The compound at token 7 is compressed; its exact grammatical agreement is slightly ambiguous.
plain_english: Those whose impressions arise from streams of concepts born of scripture contemplate that all-pervading supreme Lord, either wholly or in part, through such qualities.
